caption:
There's now a way to earn from photography without shooting anything.

Join Alux Art as a creator (free), add your bank details, and import our lighting archive into your own store. You get your own link. Every time someone relights a photo through it, ₦200 lands in your account.

No shoot. No editing. No delivery. No customer service.

Start here: aluxartandframes.shop/become-creator

slides.title: Here's the offer.

slides.title: Four steps. About five minutes.
items: Add your bank details for split payment
Import the lighting archive in one tap
Share your link and get paid per image

slides.title: ₦800 to us. ₦200 to you.
slides.body: You set your price between ₦800 and ₦1,000. Your cut is paid straight to your bank through Paystack on every sale, automatically. We email you each time one lands.

slides.title: You do none of the work.
slides.body: No shoot to run, no files to edit, no deadline to hit, no client chasing you. The tool does the job and you keep a share of it.
